edges.reason: msg.sender determines the whitelist quota and the mint recipient in adoptWhitelist.
msg.sender determines the adopt counter and the mint recipient in adopt.
msg.sender must own both parent tokens in breed.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner().
adopt requires block.timestamp >= publicTime.
breed gates on publicTime and on the BREED_ENDING_TIME window measured with block.timestamp.
distributeBonus requires block.timestamp - lastBreedTime >= BREED_ENDING_TIME.
saleStarted depends entirely on block.timestamp.
getBreedStatus result depends on block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is part of the pseudo-random seed.
tx.origin is part of the pseudo-random seed.
random() output drives the derived sex and breed count in _generateInfo.
Predictable inputs feed the randomness used for valuable attributes.
_generateInfo writes the packed butterfly info into _butterfliesInfo.
Whitelist mint forwards 80% of msg.value to the project wallet.
Public mint forwards 80% of msg.value to the project wallet.
nextTokenId is increased by quantity after the mint loop.
nextTokenId is increased by quantity after the mint loop.

Breed fee is refunded with an external transfer before breed bookkeeping completes.
Bonus payout to the breeder happens before bonus records are written.
Bonus is pushed to the last breeders through a loop of external transfers.
Ten percent of msg.value is added to currentBonus.
Ten percent of msg.value is added to currentBonus.
The breed price is added to currentBonus.
currentBonus is topped up by 1 ether, clamped to address(this).balance.
currentBonus is clamped to the contract balance, divided and then reset to zero.

breedAddressCount is accumulated from the last breeder buffer and used as divisor.

normalization_plan.reason: quantity_adopt is only meaningful as the input quantity of the adopt mint loop.
quantity_adoptWhitelist parameterises only the adoptWhitelist mint flow.
tokenId1 is only consumed by breed for parent validation and metadata reads.
tokenId2 is only consumed by breed for parent validation and metadata reads.
addresses is a transient loop input of the whitelist management function.
counts is a transient loop input paired with addresses in addToAllowList.
baseUri is immediately stored by setImageBaseURI.
_publicTime is immediately stored by setPublicTime.
_isActive is immediately stored by setWhiteListStarted.
tokenId is a transient lookup key for metadata and ownership views.
supply is a temporary snapshot of nextTokenId used by the mint function.
parentInfo1 is a transient unpacked parent record inside breed.
parentInfo2 is a transient unpacked parent record inside breed.
childGeneration is a temporary computation local to breed.
seed is a temporary randomness value used by breed for the refund roll.
sex is a temporary attribute computed inside _generateInfo.
sender is a temporary alias of msg.sender inside breed.
feeback is a temporary event flag local to breed.
breedAddressCount is a temporary divisor computed in distributeBonus.
eachBonus is a temporary payout amount computed in distributeBonus.
bredBonus is a temporary payout amount computed in breed.
rand is a temporary random value local to _generateInfo.
src is a temporary ring-buffer index local to breed.
